snippet.title: False Oath - Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
False Oath is a retro-style survival horror game set in a medieval era. A deadly plague spreads across the kingdom. Search for a cure before it’s too late.

Wishlist on Steam➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4601100/False_Oath/
